//: Compiles the pure-logic modules plus the test suite to CommonJS in
.test-build/, which `node --test` then runs. CommonJS is deliberate: the
src/ sources use extensionless relative imports ('./rubric'), which Node's
ESM resolver rejects but its CJS resolver handles natively. That lets the
whole suite run on Node's built-in test runner with no extra dependencies.
No test framework is installed on purpose. The current Vitest line requires
Vite 6+, and the Vite-5-compatible Vitest 2 line pulls in tinypool with two
node:test covers what this suite needs without that exposure.
Excludes .tsx: these are headless logic tests, not component tests.
